title: Normalization equation for derived proper-open interchange
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and write $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$, $D(v^*)$ for exact termwise pullback, $Rv_*$ for total direct image, and $Lv^*\dashv Rv_*$ for the derived adjunction, using [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let $p:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism, $i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ any open immersion, and $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow W,r:W\to\overline Y)$ a compactification of $i\circ p$ with quasi-compact open part, in the category of [det-nagata-definition-refinement]. No properness of $p$, density of $j$, or cartesianness of the square is needed for the following definitions. All functors act on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories].

Let $\theta:D(i^*)D(p^*)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(r^*)D(j^*)$ be the canonical pullback comparison formed by the termwise derived composition isomorphisms of [def-sfb-module-upper-star-comp], the equality $ip=rj$, and the inverse composition identification. Let $\beta_B:D(i^*)Rr_*B\to Rp_*D(j^*)B$ be its adjoint mate: the adjunct under $D(p^*)\dashv Rp_*$ of $\theta_{Rr_*B}$ followed by $D(j^*)$ of the counit of $D(r^*)\dashv Rr_*$. Here these exact-pullback adjunctions are the derived adjunctions transported along $Lv^*\simeq D(v^*)$.

Write $J_a=D(a_!)$ for the termwise exact open extension of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek], and $\eta_a:\mathrm{id}\to D(a^*)J_a$ for the unit of the termwise derived adjunction induced from [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek-adjunction]. For $A\in D_X$ and an arrow $m:J_iRp_*A\to Rr_*J_jA$, define the predicate that $m$ is normalized to mean precisely
$$
\operatorname{adj}_{J_i\dashv D(i^*)}(m)\,;\,\beta_{J_jA}=Rp_*(\eta_{j,A}).
$$
The semicolon denotes diagrammatic composition. Thus the left side starts at $Rp_*A$ and ends at $Rp_*D(j^*)J_jA$. This is a predicate on the specified arrow, not an assertion that any normalized arrow exists, is unique, or is invertible.
